Privacy policy

搭慕 · 담우 · Damu

Announcement: October 20, 2026 | Effective: October 20, 2026 | Version 1.0. This policy applies to Damu / 搭慕 / 담우, operated in Korea by the individual operator JIN CHENGLONG.

1. Operator and privacy lead

Damu / 搭慕 / 담우 is operated in Korea by the individual JIN CHENGLONG, not by a company or other legal entity. Privacy lead: JIN CHENGLONG; privacy, rights and complaint email: damumuapp@gmail.com; reception hours: 06:00–24:00 daily, Korea time.

2. Items, purposes, bases and retention

The tables below identify required and optional data, purpose, basis under Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act, and retention for each service activity. New items or purposes will not be used without prior notice and consent where required.

3. Visibility and sensitive data

Nickname, avatar, biography and activity content appear to the audience shown in the feature. Exact meeting points are limited to organizers and approved or attended members. Do not put unnecessary health, religion, political opinion or other sensitive data in public fields. Optional profile data can be removed, and visibility restrictions can be requested by email. Chats are visible to conversation members, who may keep separate copies.

4. Location and device permissions

With permission, nearby search obtains potentially precise foreground coordinates only for distance calculations; there is no continuous background tracking and coordinates are not sent to an external place-name service. You can refuse and select a city/area manually. The latest location is cached on the device for 30 minutes. Camera, photo and notification permissions are requested only for the related feature and can be withdrawn in system settings.

5. Processors and third-party disclosure

Processors are listed below. Other than user-directed publication, necessary display to conversation members, legal requirements and the listed processors, personal data is not disclosed to third parties. Any future independent disclosure will identify the recipient, purpose, items and retention and obtain consent where required.

6. Overseas transfers

The main database and uploads are in the AWS Seoul region. Push delivery, Apple device notifications and support email may involve processing outside Korea. Recipients, countries, items, timing/method, purpose, retention, basis and refusal options are listed below. Refusing optional push stops the related new transfer; in-app notifications remain available.

7. Retention, erasure and backups

When a period expires or a purpose ends, database records are irreversibly deleted, uploaded files are removed and any paper records are shredded. Records required by law are separated and used only for that legal purpose. Lightsail keeps the latest seven daily automatic snapshots; manually retained snapshots are deleted by the operator within 30 days. Deletion records are replayed after restoration.

8. Your rights and requests

You may request access, transmission, correction, deletion, restriction or withdrawal of consent. Edit profile data in the App or email from the registered address. Deletion: My → Settings → Account management → Delete account. The user, legal representative or authorized agent may request; only necessary identity/authority evidence is required. The operator normally responds within 10 days. A refusal or restriction will state reasons and objection steps; reply to that notice to object.

9. Automatically collected data

The service automatically processes IP address, access/login time, device platform, FCM installation ID/push token and error logs for security, sign-in, push and troubleshooting. The website uses no advertising cookies or analytics trackers. System push can be disabled in device settings while in-app notifications remain available.

10. Safeguards

Measures include salted password hashing, signed credentials, least-privilege access checks, exact-meeting-point authorization, parameterized database access and retryable deletion jobs. Chats are not end-to-end encrypted. The operator maintains transport protection, backup access controls, recovery and incident-response measures.

11. Age, automated decisions and remedies

The service is for adults aged 18 and over and is not directed to children under 14. It does not currently make decisions based solely on automated processing that significantly affect user rights. Privacy complaints may also be directed to Korea’s Privacy Infringement Report Center (118) or Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee (1833-6972).

12. Changes and version

Material changes will be announced in the App or website. New purposes, sensitive-data processing or other consent-based changes will obtain separate consent where required. Announced and effective October 20, 2026; version 1.0. Future versions will retain announcement, effective-date and history information.
